$comment: EXPLICIT ALLOWLIST of lines that ship in v1. Written from evidence produced by
`npm run inspect` — never from a blog post or a summary.
Each entry pins an exact OSM relation id AND asserts its ref, name substring and stop
count. If a mapper edits the relation upstream, the build FAILS LOUDLY rather than
silently changing fares. Re-verify against inspect output, then update the assertion.
Only ONE direction per service is listed: edges are generated bidirectionally, so the
reverse relation adds nothing but a chance of inconsistency.
Fast services are modelled as SEPARATE lines, not discarded. A fast train genuinely
runs Byculla->Dadar without stopping, so these produce real shortcut edges and better
journey times. Their union with the slow relations is also what makes coverage complete:
Central = 26 (slow) + Kasara branch + Khopoli branch = 51 stations, matching published

excluded.$comment: Deliberate v1 exclusions, recorded so they are decisions rather than oversights.
excluded.vasai-diva-memu: rel/11491143 + rel/11491142 — Vasai Road–Diva MEMU service. Real, but outside the v1 scope agreed in the plan (Western/Central/Harbour/Trans-Harbour/Nerul–Uran). Revisit for v2.
excluded.under-construction: OSM also carries Line 4 (Green, u/c) and Line 11. Excluded by the network tag filter; must stay excluded until they actually open.
excluded.trans-harbour-thane-panvel: rel/11511942 is an INCOMPLETE relation — 14 stops, terminating at Khandeshwar and omitting Panvel itself. rel/11511951 (Panvel=>Thane, 15 stops) is used instead.

lines.$sourceNote: Mumbai Monorail has NO route relation in OpenStreetMap — only railway=monorail ways and 17 station=monorail nodes, which carry no sequence. The order below is hand-curated and then VALIDATED two ways: it covers exactly the 17 OSM station nodes with none missing or extra, and it contains no backward hop when walked geographically. Note a published blog list was found to be WRONG (it invents a 'Chinchpokli' station and omits 'Antop Hill'); the OSM node set is authoritative on which stations exist. Verified 2026-08-06.
lines.$distanceNote: Distances are measured along guideway where a consecutive pair shares a mapped fragment, and straight-line CALIBRATED to the published 19.54 km total otherwise. Straight-line total is only 15.21 km because the alignment is unusually winding (the Wadala loop), so uncalibrated haversine would under-report distance and therefore under-report fare.

$operatorNote: Operators are defined by FARE AUTHORITY, not by mode. Mumbai Metro Line 1 (MMOPL), Lines 2A/2B/7/9 (MMMOCL) and Line 3 (MMRC) are separate companies with separate ticketing and different fare tables, so crossing between them restarts the fare and requires a paid transfer. Modelling all six as one 'mumbai-metro' operator would under-charge every Line 1 <-> Line 3 journey and wrongly make Marol Naka a free platform change. Corrected 2026-08-06.
